lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank, arranged in three irregular vertical columns and three horizontal rows posterior to the gills.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A strong horizontal linear feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Two distinct high-luminance blobs are localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, positioned along the anterior and middle sections of the fin's surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep indentation and loss of tissue are visible on the dorsal ridge between the first and second dorsal fins, accompanied by a vertical linear scar feature extending ventrally from the site of the injury.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller fish (remoras) are visible as dark, elongated silhouettes attached to the ventral and posterior-lateral regions of the shark's body.
